evals.name: bookmarks-feature-module
evals.prompt: Add a Bookmarks screen to our Android app (Kotlin, Compose, Hilt, multi-module with core:* and feature:* modules). It shows the posts the user saved, newest first, with loading, empty and error states, and tapping a post opens the existing post detail screen in feature:post. `core:data` already has a `PostsRepository`; bookmarks are a new endpoint `GET /me/bookmarks`. Write the Kotlin and Gradle files you'd add, stubbing what you assume exists, and the tests.
evals.expected_output: A feature:bookmarks module that doesn't depend on feature:post (navigation through a NavKey wired in app), a BookmarksViewModel exposing one UiState as StateFlow via stateIn(WhileSubscribed) with ImmutableList, a stateful Route and stateless Screen collecting with collectAsStateWithLifecycle, stringResource copy, separate DTO and model, an injected dispatcher, a fake repository and a Turbine ViewModel test, PascalCase file names.
expectations: feature:bookmarks does not depend on feature:post; navigation to post detail goes through a key/lambda wired in app
The ViewModel exposes one UiState as StateFlow via stateIn(..., WhileSubscribed(...))
Lists in the UiState are ImmutableList
A stateful Route composable obtains the ViewModel; the Screen composable below it is stateless
UI copy uses stringResource, no string literals in composables
Network DTO and the domain/UI model are separate types
A ViewModel test uses a fake repository (Turbine or equivalent)
File names are PascalCase after their top-level declaration

evals.name: review-planted-violations
evals.prompt: Review this Android PR diff (files/review.diff) and tell me what needs to change before it merges.
evals.expected_output: Flags: ViewModel holding NavController and Context, collectAsState instead of collectAsStateWithLifecycle, a Channel of one-shot effects, Dispatchers.IO inline, List in UiState, token in SharedPreferences, hard-coded string, feature-to-feature dependency.
expectations: Flags the ViewModel holding a NavController
Flags the ViewModel holding a Context
Flags the Channel of one-shot errors (should be state consumed by the screen)
Flags Dispatchers.IO written inline instead of an injected dispatcher
Flags List<RecentAccount> in UiState (should be ImmutableList)
Flags the token stored in SharedPreferences (needs a Keystore-backed secure store)
Flags hard-coded strings in the composable/ViewModel
